units.fit_note: Consent for sharing interaction data, including for research; P50 is mostly about protecting data. Concerns consent for sharing student interaction data, not protecting data from tools.

units.passage: Sensitive and Restricted Data, as defined in the Acceptable Use policy, must not be entered into AI tools without prior approval
units.why: 'Sensitive and Restricted Data ... must not be entered into AI tools without prior approval' bans entering protected data, P50.

units.passage: The tool is approved for Sensitive and/or Restricted Data use as applicable per the approved AI tools list, and
units.why: Approval requires that the tool be 'approved for Sensitive and/or Restricted Data use ... per the approved AI tools list' and the use case approved by the Data Ethics Committee, i.e. use of vetted tools, P50.
units.fit_note: Also requires committee approval of the use case.

units.passage: A New IT Solutions and Services Review is required for use of any AI tools, whether developed externally or internally, not already on the approved AI tools list.
units.why: 'A New IT Solutions and Services Review is required for use of any AI tools ... not already on the approved AI tools list' requires vetting before use, P50.

units.passage: Usage authorization review by the Data Ethics Committee is initiated by completion of a Data Ethics Committee Use Case Review
units.why: 'Usage authorization review by the Data Ethics Committee is initiated by completion of a ... Use Case Review' sets another approval step before sensitive-use cases; P65.
units.fit_note: Use-case review by the Data Ethics Committee rather than review of the tool itself.

units.passage: However, caution must be used, as information entered into AI tools for which an appropriate agreement has not been established may become the property of the tool provider and be used in training its services or shared directly with others
units.why: Warns that information entered into AI tools without an agreement 'may become the property of the tool provider and be used in training', a data and IP risk, P50.

units.passage: The purpose of this policy is to establish guidelines for use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) at Rensselaer to maintain compliance with existing over-arching policies on information security and privacy to safeguard institutional data.
units.policy: The generative AI policy aims to safeguard institutional data.
units.why: The stated aim "to safeguard institutional data" ties the generative AI policy to data protection (P50). Only the purpose statement was retrievable, so no further rules are coded.
units.fit_note: States the aim of protecting institutional data only; no instruction about personal data or vetted tools.

units.passage: Protect sensitive and institutional data from misuse and unauthorized access
units.why: "Protect sensitive and institutional data from misuse and unauthorized access" is the Privacy and Security principle; P50. A Guiding Principle, so should.

units.passage: Follow URI’s Data Classification Guidelines to avoid exposing restricted or sensitive information.
units.policy: Follow URI’s Data Classification Guidelines to avoid exposing restricted or sensitive information
units.why: "Follow URI’s Data Classification Guidelines to avoid exposing restricted or sensitive information" is the Data Security and Privacy standard, an enforced standard binding all users; P50, must.

units.passage: Avoid inputting private or restricted data, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or patient records, into public AI tools like ChatGPT.
units.policy: Avoid inputting private or restricted data, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or patient records, into public AI tools like ChatGPT
units.why: "Avoid inputting private or restricted data, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII) or patient records, into public AI tools like ChatGPT" is the Prohibited Data Use standard, a ban on one kind of input, so must-not. P50 (protect personal data) fits it; AI use itself stays allowed, so unit stance restrict.
units.fit_note: Bans entering PII or restricted data into public AI tools; P50 is about protecting data and preferring vetted tools, not specifically about a prohibition.

units.passage: Be cautious when using AI platforms, as data entered may be transmitted to third-party servers.
units.why: "Be cautious when using AI platforms, as data entered may be transmitted to third-party servers" is the Data Handling Awareness standard, a caution about data privacy; P50, should because "be cautious" is advisory.
